summary: The revised easy generator and five-record batch pass all eight checks. Package files are unchanged. Five affected legacy inventory records are documented separately.

source_analysis.skill: Solve homogeneous first-order ODEs using y=v(x)x, separation, integration and back-substitution.
invariants: Preserve the homogeneous equation and easy integration workload.
Provide five radio choices with exactly one correct general solution.
Keep prompt, solution, answer and domain consistent.
permitted_variations: Vary eligible correct candidates within a fixed answer bank.
Vary distractors and presentation without changing the mathematical response.

source_replay.details: Nine supported replay cases retain their prompts, complete banks, correct answers and worked solutions. Unsupported source families are explicitly documented.

math.details: Independent differentiation verifies exactly one correct candidate in each of 152 tested records, including the exact batch.

variety.details: All 18 bank windows per family were exercised. Nine fixed-bank groups each support five correct assignments. No tested bank-only strategy solves the entire runner batch.

scope.details: Revised easy instances preserve the three source integration branches, workload and radio response contract. Broader moderate generation is outside this acceptance.

grading.details: Native grader: 155 accepted and 617 rejected responses, zero unresolved. Tests include every candidate and stale responses across counterfactuals.

rendering.details: All 17 actual-UI renders passed. Representative worked solutions and every rendered prompt and answer bank were visually inspected.

packaging.details: Exact dependency version, determinism, relocation and invalid-input rejection pass. Retained assertions fail legacy construction and pass the revision. Recursive package hashes are unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Relevant changes update prompts, explanations, answers and grading; irrelevant reorder preserves responses. Delivery retains 106/123 independent records and all five runner records. Selection rules were examined read-only. Five unchanged legacy defects remain documented separately.
